description: This file defines the Tax class within the OpenCart system, responsible for calculating and adding tax totals to the cart total. It includes a method getTotal that processes tax values and updates the totals and total sum accordingly.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: A class that manages the calculation and integration of tax totals into the overall cart totals in OpenCart.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates tax totals and updates the provided totals array and total amount based on the taxes array.
